filled.description:
Whether or not this specific instance has been processed. Especially helpful when calls from the
front end require full resolution and serves as a marker for server to know entire instance has
been fully resolved.

exposedVariables.description:
{@link App.Metric.Variable} that are exposed to the user for dynamic evaluation at runtime of
the contained {@link App.Metric}s.
Unless {@link doNotInferExposedVariables} is set, if not defined on instance, {@link #validateAndFill} will
populate with output of {@link unresolvedVariables}. This is a convenience for instances that do not
need to explicitly exclude any {@link App.Metric.Variable} from being resolved at runtime.

doNotInferExposedVariables.description:
When true, {@link #validateAndFill} will not infer {@link #exposedVariables} if it is empty.
When false, {@link #validateAndFill} will set {@link #unresolvedVariables} into {@link #exposedVariables}
if {@link #unresolvedVariables} is not set.
This flag will be ignored if {@link #exposedVariables} is set.
This boolean is present because there is no type system distinguishment for entities between null
and empty arrays.

title: Abstraction for concepts that contain references to {@link App.Metric} that are to be evaluated at runtime.
name: App.Metric.Container
